justification: Assessment reported INVALID and targeted exactly the ground-truth defect: the proof tries to derive, from only (A sorted non-decreasing, l < r, A[l]+A[r] < t), that no r' > r has A[l]+A[r'] = t, omitting the needed side condition that r is the largest index. Its witness A=[1,2,3,10], t=11, l=0, r=2, r'=3 is a valid countermodel of the same claim (sorted; 0<2; 1+3=4<11; 1+10=11=t), a different-but-valid instance of the ground-truth witness family.
